info.title: bmo-review
info.description: Code review over git checkouts: projects named as the settings name them, their trees, files and commits at a revision, each commit's diff, content and definition searches, reviews of a revision with their comments on its lines, files and folders, and items a review files into the job service through its client. Who wrote a review or a comment is an opaque authorName. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys; times are integers of epoch milliseconds. A list is a page, `after` being the cursor each route states. A revision is seven to sixty-four hex characters, HEAD where absent. A file's path stands as the rest of the path. Every failure is answered in the error shape with its status. Every route takes the service token; where a console face stands, every route is answered again under `/screen`, the console's prefix, to the console credential alone and guarded as bmo-ui's console plugin contract states, and the console face's manifest and files are stated under the `console` tag. The harness plugin's tools, each a thin call of one route, are stated under `x-tools`.

x-harness.entry: A harness reads a change with review_diff, writes its findings with review_create and review_comment, and files a follow-up item with review_file_item.

Error.description: Every failure: a stable kebab-case code a caller decides on, and an English sentence it decides nothing on.

A failure, in the common error shape. The codes:
- `bad-request` (400): the body, the query or the path is not the shape the route takes
- `unauthorized` (401): the bearer token is missing or wrong
- `forbidden` (403): under /screen, or for the console bundle's module and stylesheet, the console's call names no role that opens the screen
- `no-route` (404): no route answers the method and path
- `not-found` (404): nothing stands at the project, the revision, the path, the review or the console bundle's file the request names
- `conflict` (409): the review's states do not allow the change
- `gone` (410): the events since the number asked for are no longer kept
- `unreadable-checkout` (422): the project's checkout is missing, in no git repository or without commits
- `unknown-project` (422): a review names a project the settings do not name
- `unknown-revision` (422): a review names a revision that resolves to no commit of the project
- `no-such-place` (422): a comment's place is no file or folder of the revision, or its lines lie off the file
- `not-a-name` (422): the definition search does not take the word
- `filing-refused` (422): the job service refused the item
- `failed` (500): the service failed
- `upstream-failed` (502): the job service could not be reached or failed
